ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 252 Section ADE is the Honors section for MCB honors students and James Scholars. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu for information and approval. Both lecture and discussions begin on Monday, August 27, 2012. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 18, October 16, and November 13, 2012. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment.
